title: Singular value decomposition and forms on inner product spaces
objectives: Prove and compute the singular value decomposition
Distinguish the matrix of a form from the matrix of an operator
Diagonalize Hermitian forms by principal axes
prerequisites: The spectral theorem (Chapter 25), the representation theorem (Chapter 23) and Gram-Schmidt.
source_scope: The captions of the two recordings (positions 59 and 60) were read in full. The three by two example comes from the first; the running matrix, positivity criterion, change-of-basis rules, laboratory and exercises are original.
